text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia is ready to implement projects in Iraq worth $10 billion after the end of the (U.N.) embargo.
- President Saddam Hussein sends condolences to Omani leader on the death of Oman's deputy premier.
- Iraq to be represented at the world health conference that will be held in Rome.
(The above stories were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and THAWRA)
- Vietnam is willing to enhance trade cooperation with Iraq.
- Iraq to submit to the world health conference a working paper on the impact of trade sanctions on Iraqis.
